title: Gate review prefetch holds a pending gate for offline review
description: Use a private farm with one pending ready gate on a real package and three active runs on slot repositories to observe prefetch order, offline gate review with both diff sides held, an untracked file beside a gitignored .env, fix-loop transfer bytes, gate diff open measurements and an operator principal's refusal stop. Under the current gateway authorization prefetch needs admin reads (run.get, git.diff, git.show, decision.list), so an admin principal signs in for every check except the refusal; the operator signs in last, and its refusal is observed in the same tab right after sign-in and again on a reloaded page. No GitHub, provider, native or worker CLI execution.

proofTargets.claim: On the first connection with a pending gate and three active runs, the gate's run.get is the first prefetch read and no more than two runs are prefetched at once.
With the gateway stopped, a new browser runtime renders the gate's details, package diff and evidence images from the store and sends no gateway frame.

For every size-eligible touched file the store holds the base blob by id and a new side whose git blob id matches the package diff or untracked manifest; the over-cap and binary files are not prefetched.
An active run's untracked new file is in its held diff with its new side held, and its gitignored .env appears in no recorded websocket frame and no stored row or byte.
A new package for the same gate transfers only its new diff over HTTP, and batched git.show lists the held bases and sends none of them again.

Opening the gate diff is measured on five new documents each with nothing held, after prefetch, and offline from held content, counting gateway frames and /api/run-artifact bytes and naming the read that supplied the diff.

An operator's first prefetch read is the gate's run.get; once its refusal reaches the page no further prefetch read is sent on that connection, in the same tab after sign-in and on a reloaded page; a forced reconnect is refused once more and stops again, and nothing is stored.

prove.intent: Observe gate review prefetch, offline review and refusal in the real browser.

gateReviewPrefetchOrder.intent: The pending gate is read first and at most two runs are in flight.

gateReviewOffline.intent: The gate's details, diff and evidence images render offline.

gateReviewBothSides.intent: Eligible bases are held by id and new sides match their blob ids.

gateReviewUntrackedEnv.intent: The untracked file is held and the ignored .env never leaves the slot.

gateReviewFixLoopBytes.intent: A new package moves only its new diff; held bases are not sent again.

gateReviewDiffMeasured.intent: Gate diff open is measured with nothing held, after prefetch and offline.

gateReviewRefusalStops.intent: The gate's refused run.get stops prefetch until a new connection.
